stories.title: How a GOP redistricting 'dummymander' in North Carolina backfired by 2 seats
stories.summary: In North Carolina, Republican lawmakers redrew voting maps, aiming to gain one seat in Congress. Instead, they lost two seats, in a classic example of what political scientists call a "dummymander."
stories.why: District lines translate votes into seats, and interested actors draw them.
